label: Richard Amesbury, Fideism §4, A different…: Reading of Über Gewißheit: hinges are not propositions…
locator: §4, A different reading, advanced by, inter alia, Danièle Moyal-Sharrock
interpretation: The entry: Moyal-Sharrock 'holds that the hinges are not empty propositions because they are not propositions at all; rather, they are phenomenological descriptions of "the mindless, animal certainty with which we move about in the world" (67)'. Attribution reading of the position the entry reports, not a view of the entry's author.
attribution: The passage states that Moyal-Sharrock holds that hinges are not propositions at all but descriptions of the animal certainty with which we move about in the world, which is the premise.
